desc: Derive and document the reduction to a maximum-bottleneck path and the closed-form answer formula: answer = |Y-Z| if M>=min(Y,Z), else Y+Z-2M, where M is the largest maintainable floor along some cell path.

Implement offline DSU with small-to-large query sets: attach each query to both endpoint cells, process cells in descending F, union active neighbors, and merge query-id sets small-into-large; when a query id is found in both merged roots, set its bottleneck M to the merge height.
Handle same-cell queries immediately (M=F[cell]) and remove resolved queries from sets so total set work stays O((N+Q) log N).
Implement fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()) and efficient output of Q answers.
Validate against Sample 1 (expect 10 and 2) and edge cases: same block, same row/column, equal heights.
